pr.title: feat: add DataTable component with sorting and pagination
pr.author: shadcn

summary.assessment: Generally solid implementation. One warning about missing keyboard navigation accessibility and one informational note about bundle size impact. Safe to merge after addressing the accessibility gap.

agentResults.summary: No security issues found. The component is purely presentational with no data fetching, authentication, or external calls.

findings.title: DataTable missing keyboard navigation for sorting controls
findings.description: The sortable column headers are implemented as `<div onClick>` elements rather than `<button>` elements. This makes them inaccessible to keyboard-only users and screen readers. The existing Table component uses proper semantic elements throughout — this regresses that standard.
findings.suggestion: Replace `<div onClick={handleSort}>` with `<Button variant='ghost' onClick={handleSort}>` or a native `<button>`. Add `aria-sort` attribute that updates to 'ascending' or 'descending' based on sort state.

evidenceRefs.snippet: column.toggleSorting()} > {header}
evidenceRefs.reason: Non-interactive div used as click target — not keyboard reachable, no aria-sort

agentResults.summary: The implementation is consistent with shadcn/ui patterns except for sortable column headers using div elements instead of buttons, which breaks keyboard accessibility.
The component ships with Storybook stories covering the main usage patterns and a Vitest unit test for sorting logic. Coverage is acceptable for a UI component library.

findings.title: Documentation does not mention @tanstack/react-table peer dependency
findings.description: The DataTable component requires `@tanstack/react-table` as a peer dependency, but the installation instructions in the MDX docs only show `npx shadcn-ui add data-table` without mentioning the peer dep. Users who already have a project without @tanstack/react-table installed will get a runtime error with no clear diagnosis.
findings.suggestion: Add a note in the installation section: 'This component requires @tanstack/react-table. Install it with: `npm install @tanstack/react-table`'. Consider adding it to the CLI scaffolding's dependency install step.
